com.altastata.filesystem.common

Class FileSystemHandler

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.altastata.filesystem.common.FileSystemHandler

  • public class FileSystemHandler
extends java.lang.Object
    Core handler managing the lifecycle, resolution, and event dispatching for files within the file system. `FileSystemHandler` acts as the orchestrator connecting raw cloud object models to application-level behavior. It tracks files currently in use, manages files mid-upload, computes and filters file timestamps (versions), and resolves nested directory trees. It is also responsible for converting string paths and cloud object keys into `CloudFile` domain objects, handling path obfuscation logic behind the scenes.

      • detectTimestamps

        public java.util.List<java.lang.Long> detectTimestamps(CloudFile[] origFiles,
                                                       boolean onlyLatestVersion)
        Extracts all unique timestamps (creation times) from the specified file trees. This is typically used to build historical version timelines. It scans the provided directories concurrently, retrieving metadata to construct a comprehensive map of file paths to their available versions.
        Parameters:
        origFiles - The list of root files or directories to scan.
        onlyLatestVersion - If true, only the most recent timestamp for each file is returned.
        Returns:
        A sorted list of unique epoch timestamps representing file versions.

        onlyLatestVersion - If true, filters down to only the most recent timestamp for each file path.

      • detectTimestampsPerFile

        public java.util.Map<java.lang.String,java.util.List<java.lang.Long>> detectTimestampsPerFile(CloudFile[] origFiles)
        Detects and maps all creation timestamps (versions) for each of the given files. Launches parallel tasks using the timestamps thread pool for efficient scanning.

      • getWithSubtrees

        public CloudFile[] getWithSubtrees(CloudFile[] origFiles,
                                   AltaStataFileSystem.OperationState setDirectoryOperationState,
                                   java.util.List<java.lang.Long> timestampsFilter)
        Resolves a list of files or directories into a complete set of individual `CloudFile` objects, optionally flattening subdirectories. It intelligently decides whether to list each subtree individually or to issue a bulk `LIST` operation against a common prefix (e.g., when deleting multiple files in the same folder).
        Parameters:
        origFiles - The selected input files/directories.
        setDirectoryOperationState - The state to apply to directories (e.g., DOWNLOADING, DELETING).
        timestampsFilter - Specifies which historical versions should be included.
        Returns:
        A flattened array of fully resolved `CloudFile` objects.

      • findCloudFile

      • tryToDeleteFile

        public void tryToDeleteFile(CloudFile cloudFile)
        Cleans up local data structures (like `cloudFilesInUse` and `cloudFilesInUploadingProcess`) after a file deletion completes. It intelligently traverses the directory tree upwards. If a file still has versions remaining (i.e., not fully deleted), it ensures parent directories are kept alive. If the file is fully deleted, it removes it from local caches and recursively removes empty parent directories that were also marked for deletion.
        Parameters:
        cloudFile - The file that was just deleted or had versions removed.

      • mapFilesTreeToCloudFileList

        public java.util.List<scala.Tuple2<java.io.File,CloudFile>> mapFilesTreeToCloudFileList(java.util.List<java.io.File> selectedLocalFilesOrDirs,
                                                                                        java.lang.String baseLocalDir,
                                                                                        java.lang.String targetCloudDir,
                                                                                        long createTime)
        Recursively walks a list of local files or directories and maps them to their respective target cloud destination paths, returning a structured list of file pairs. Supports multi-level nesting. Strips a local base via Path.relativize(java.nio.file.Path) (not String.replace(char, char)) so path mapping cannot accidentally rewrite mid-string. When roots come from different folders, each root falls back to its own parent as base.
        Parameters:
        selectedLocalFilesOrDirs - The root local files or directories to map.
        baseLocalDir - The local path prefix to strip when roots share that folder.
        targetCloudDir - The cloud path prefix to substitute in place of baseLocalDir.
        createTime - The epoch timestamp to assign to the new file versions.
        Returns:
        A list of Scala Tuple2 mapping each local File to its destination CloudFile.

      • attemptToSetAncestorsOperationStateAsNONE

        public void attemptToSetAncestorsOperationStateAsNONE(CloudFile cloudFile)
        Recursively resets ancestor directory operation states to AltaStataFileSystem.OperationState.NONE once all sibling transfers/operations nested under them have finished successfully. This prevents parent folders from remaining in transient/busy states (such as DOWNLOADING or UPLOADING) in the UI or client logic when the actual work is completed.
        Parameters:
        cloudFile - The child CloudFile that has completed its active operation.
